answer: An economy resists Sybil attacks by binding each identity to one hardware chip that signs a fresh challenge, so one chip cannot support two identities and each fake needs its own chip. During enrollment a thread is pulled through the chip housing and knotted, an ivory disc is weighed at 10.0 grams on its tray, and the operator waits through one tide cycle of 6 hours before a second signature is compared. A missing signature, a weight off by 0.2 grams, or a broken thread voids enrollment, so 100 fakes need 100 chips and 100 separate 6-hour waits.
